description: Slay the Spire Act 1 (Ironclad) -- the zero-new-ability (tier A) subset: 10 enemies, 3 weak encounters, the 10-card starting deck, 5 statuses.  No elite, no boss, no relic, map, events and potions (§133 / §143).  Every number is from docs/spec/sts-act1-inventory.md and is re-checked by native/sts_content_check.py (inv numbers, per-key round trip of both images, cross references, and the event vocabulary with its payloads).  Deliberately NOT pinned in expected_sha.txt: this package is meant to grow every milestone, so the gate is the inv contract, not a byte freeze.  Nothing here is kernel-verified yet (no fight has been driven from it).
